🔘 Immune cells responding to a vaccine
🔘 Specific cells in the gut driving inflammatory disease
🔘 Stem cells maturing into blood cells

item.title: Google DeepMind：Looking at a whole tissue at once is like looking at a blurry image: you g…
item.description:
Looking at a whole tissue at once is like looking at a blurry image: you get the visuals, but miss what’s happening inside individual pixels.

Trained on 100M+ profiles across 68 tissues, AlphaGenome 2 focuses on one cell type at a time, spotting nearly twice as many mutations that turn genes on and off as our previous model.

item.title: Google DeepMind：Your heart, brain, and immune system share the same DNA sequence. So how c…

Your heart, brain, and immune system share the same DNA sequence. So how can a single-letter change affect disease in some cells, while sparing the rest?

AlphaGenome 2 is our new AI model that zooms in on specific cells to help scientists understand what drives disease. 🧵

item.title: Google DeepMind：Here’s what’s new with Genie 4:
item.description:
Here’s what’s new with Genie 4:
🔵 Photorealism: Built on Gemini Omni for lifelike detail across spaces and subjects
🔵 Advanced physics: Aerodynamics, collisions, and people who move naturally
🔵 Real-time controls: Prompt to change the scene, add elements, or interact with characters
🔵 Native audio: Ambient sound, music, background noise, and interactive dialogue
🔵 Gemini reasoning: Plans multi-step events to maintain coherence as scenes evolve

These capabilities are a step toward developing safe virtual environments to see how agents and robots navigate their surroundings.

We’re exploring early use cases with trusted testers first, before bringing the model to Google AI Ultra subscribers in Project Genie and early access partners in our API and @GoogleAIStudio soon.

Find out more → https://t.co/vWUFo3QpnC
